modules.description: Trình phát sáng/tối với ảnh bìa bo góc, đĩa than xoay, thanh bên mảnh và đường seek lượn sóng. Studio tùy biến (hàng mảnh ghép trong menu): xem trước trực tiếp, 8 bộ cài sẵn, kiểu nền Video bài hát/Sóng biển/Mưa/Tuyết rơi/Vụ nổ/Sao băng (hoặc tắt), lớp phủ và màu phủ nền, màu tên bài, nghệ sĩ, lời bài hát, màu đĩa than, màu rãnh, cỡ trình phát và cỡ lời. Tự động theo bìa: màu nền đổi theo từng bìa nhạc. Hiệu ứng theo bass, nốt nhạc bay, chế độ tĩnh, ẩn đĩa than, nút tim/shuffle/repeat có hiệu ứng. | Light and dark player with a rounded cover, spinning vinyl, a slim side rail and a wavy seek line. A Studio page (the puzzle-piece row in the menu) with a live preview, 8 presets, background styles Song video/Ocean waves/Rain/Snow/Explosion/Meteors (or off), background veil and tint, colours for title, artist, lyrics, vinyl and grooves, plus player and lyric size. Auto cover makes colours and background style follow each cover. Bass-reactive effects, floating notes, calm mode, hidden vinyl and animated heart, shuffle and repeat buttons.

modules.name: Cassette Queue
modules.author: you
modules.description: Vertical cassette with the next songs as cassette spines. Styles: classic, closed case and cassette with an info insert. Immersive mode animates the cassette swap (eject, tilt, click into place). Plastic textures: micro-scratches, friction wear, aging, fingerprint smudges and holographic sheen. Players: Cassette Queue; Pixel Deck (pixel-art or realistic skin, uses the cassette options); Cassette Shelf (a shelf of spines around the current cassette, closed cases behind it, portrait column of spines with a 'peek' option, bigger shelf in landscape); Cassette Stage (landscape: big cassette, deck keys and a rack with the playing, previous and next spines). In landscape the cassette lies horizontally in every style. Backgrounds: Adaptive color and Wood. Player size, vertical position and shelf cassette size sliders. 2.9.5-2.9.7: new option 'Animated cover art' that plays the song's animated cover over the album art on every cassette and case, (including the closed case behind it in Cassette Shelf landscape), and on the playing spine in Cassette Shelf portrait (which now also shows its cover).

modules.name: Yeno's Orbit Tablet
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Official tablet edition: the whole player is drawn larger and the sky is stretched so it reaches the top and bottom edges of the screen, in landscape and portrait. Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v1.3: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: four more space backgrounds - pulsar, eclipse, solar system and constellations - each in its own corner of the sky, on top of the galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen. Tablet edition: everything enlarged to fill a tablet screen, and the volume bar sits clear of the play button. A DPI fix slider scales the whole player up further. Update (cover no longer dims when lyrics are off): Spinning cover is now a speed menu (Very slow to Fast), Lyrics style has an Off choice that keeps lyrics off the album cover, and the unused 'Lyric line under the title' option is gone. In the Solar system sky the sun is small and sits at the left of the sky with the planets circling it. The planets are now round and lit by the sun, with fading orbit trails, banded Jupiter, a ringed Saturn and a softer sun glow.
